metadata.title: X Lead Miner — find buyers on X
metadata.description: X Lead Miner watches X around the clock for posts that sound like buying intent and turns them into a scored lead queue. Built for founders, freelancers and sales teams.

landing.heroTitle: Find buyers on X before your competitors do
landing.heroSubtitle: X Lead Miner watches X around the clock for posts that sound like buying intent — recommendation requests, tool comparisons, competitor complaints — and turns them into a scored lead queue for founders, freelancers and sales teams.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From a handful of keywords to a ranked queue of people ready to buy.

steps.title: Describe your market
steps.body: Add the keywords your buyers type when they’re in the market: product categories, competitor names, and phrases like “anyone recommend” or “alternative to”.

steps.title: The miner keeps watching
steps.body: Your searches run continuously over public X posts, filtering out noise and bots so real buying signals surface.

steps.title: Work the queue, not the feed
steps.body: Matches land in a ranked queue with the post, the author and why it matched. Reply on X, mark it handled, move to the next.

features.title: Built to surface intent, not noise
features.subtitle: Everything turns the firehose of X into a working pipeline.

items.title: Intent-first monitoring
items.body: Tracks the phrases buyers actually type — “anyone recommend”, “alternative to”, “worth paying for” — instead of waiting on brand mentions.

items.title: Lead scoring
items.body: Every match is ranked by intent strength, author signals and recency, so the hottest posts sit at the top of your queue.

items.title: Alerts before threads move on
items.body: A daily digest plus real-time alerts for high-intent matches, so you reach buyers while your reply still gets seen.

items.title: Competitor radar
items.body: Watch competitors’ names and catch their unhappy users at the exact moment they’re ready to switch.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when it sticks.

items.question: What counts as a lead?
items.answer: Any public X post that matches one of your saved searches and clears your intent threshold — typically someone asking for recommendations, comparing options, or complaining about what they use today.

items.question: Which X data does it read?
items.answer: Public posts only, through the official X API. Private accounts and DMs are never read, and nothing is ever posted to X on your behalf.

items.question: Does it auto-reply to leads for me?
items.answer: No. You get the post, the author and why it matched — the reply stays yours. Hand-written replies convert better and keep your account in good standing.

items.question: How is this different from X search or saved alerts?
items.answer: X search makes you re-run the query and dig through noise by hand. X Lead Miner keeps your searches always-on, scores every match, and only surfaces the posts worth a reply.

intent.title: Intent lab
intent.subtitle: The PyTorch model behind lead scoring: frozen sentence embeddings + a small trained head. Pipeline lives in intent/.

collect.title: Collect

train.title: Train head
train.detail: Frozen sentence embedder (default: embeddinggemma-2, 2026-10) → MLP dim-64-1 → precision@k on holdout.
